title: DR-10: rto-01 ratchet_tree is optional<Node><V>
description: draft-ietf-mls-ratchet-tree-options-01 §3 writes 'Node ratchet_tree<V>' but describes the field as the complete ratchet_tree extension. Readings: (a) literal Node<V>; (b) RFC 9420 ratchet_tree extension form optional<Node> ratchet_tree<V>. Chosen: (b) — blank nodes require optional<>. WG question filed.
